_comment: Terrain surfaces (see include/Surfaces.h). Each ground tile is tagged with a surface in the LDtk tileset editor (the 'Surface' enum); the importer reads that tag and looks the surface up here. Names MUST match the LDtk enum values exactly (LDtk capitalizes them). 'walkable' drives terrain collision -- water blocks like Pokemon shore edges, no separate collision layer. The surface name is also the join key for per-surface footsteps (config/footsteps.json). 'default' applies to any tile with no surface tag (bare grass fill).
